SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-24-2026 - JUDGMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-24-2026 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-24-2026 BY JUDGE PRO TEM JOSE FREDRICKS. PLAINTIFF MUN MAY TEE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT AIR BNB IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM APPEARANCE REPRESENTED BY ANDREW SIMS, PARALEGAL. THE COURT ALLOWS AIRBNB'S APPEARANCE AFTER ADMONISHMENT. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: JOSH M. FREDRICKS; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TEE, MUN MAY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT AIR BNB $6,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $130.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,630.00, JUDGMENT FOR PLAINTIFF VS DEFENDANT. MOLD DAMAGE IS EXCLUDED FROM AGREEMENT. HOWEVER, COURT FINDS THAT SUBSTANTIAL DAMAGE WAS CAUSED BY POOLING WATER, E.G. BUCKLING. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
